business_summary: China Fortune Land Development Co., Ltd. engages in the operation of various assets, such as industrial parks and innovation centers in China. The company offers investment promotion and operation services; and professional services, such as park planning consultation, building development, industrial investment and park operation, industrial services, industrial investment, and asset management, as well as industrial leasing and industrial new town services. The company was formerly known as China Fortune Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. and changed its name to China Fortune Land Development Co., Ltd. in December 2007. China Fortune Land Development Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
business_summary_ko: China Fortune Land Development Co., Ltd.는 중국 내 산업단지, 혁신센터 등 다양한 자산을 운영하고 있습니다. 회사는 투자 촉진 및 운영 서비스를 제공합니다. 공원계획 상담, 건물개발, 산업투자 및 공원운영, 산업서비스, 산업투자, 자산관리 등의 전문서비스와 산업임대, 산업신도시 서비스 등을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 China Fortune Real Estate Development Co., Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2007년 12월에 China Fortune Land Development Co., Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. China Fortune Land Development Co., Ltd.는 1993년에 설립되었으며 중국 베이징에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
